qualification: Local scoped gates passed; no deployment, remote CI, push or native distribution performed. Overall production release requires the remaining PRs.

nginxProductionConfig.fixture: Disposable loopback Docker container, synthetic certificate and upstreams

proxySecretInstaller.scope: Temporary files only; generation, invalid input, idempotence and mode 0600

trustChain.edge: Only configured Cloudflare peers may attest CF-Connecting-IP; Nginx overwrites client forwarding headers
trustChain.internal: Nginx/BFF/API share a private proxy credential; BFF request-local AsyncLocalStorage
trustChain.apiFallback: Raw socket IP; Express trust proxy false; never request.ip or an unauthenticated forwarding header
trustChain.networkRequirement: Keep API/frontend ports loopback/private; possession of proxy secret is an internal authority

policy.accountResolution: No account existence lookup. Portal includes organization slug; token-only endpoints budget by opaque credential, not stable user across rotation.
policy.broadSuiteLimits: Explicit 100000 budgets for synthetic shared origins; security suite overrides to 2
policy.sqlAccess: FORCE RLS, no runtime table policies; specific SECURITY DEFINER function with fixed search_path and explicit execute grant
policy.transientRefresh: 429/503/transport failures preserve tokens and propagate temporary error in web and mobile
policy.boundedStorageCaveat: Bounded rows and cleanup batch; not a hard WAL/bloat byte limit or volumetric DDoS protection

concurrencyProof: Two NestJS applications in one test process, independent Prisma clients/pools, shared restricted PostgreSQL runtime role; eight concurrent requests yield exactly two admissions.
